intensity_fraction.label: Share of event rainfall concentrated in the wettest day
intensity_fraction.definition: Maximum daily event rainfall divided by total event rainfall. A positive trend moves toward short, concentrated rainfall; a negative trend moves toward long, volume-dominated rainfall.
intensity_fraction.unit: percentage points of event rainfall per decade

intensity_050.label: Share of extreme events classified as intensity-dominated
intensity_050.definition: Selected extreme events for which more than half of event rainfall fell in the wettest day. This thresholded view is interpretive; rainfall concentration is the primary continuous metric.

ssi_1d.label: One-day antecedent Soil Saturation Index
ssi_1d.definition: Mean SSI over the complete day before event rainfall begins.

ssi_3d.label: Three-day antecedent Soil Saturation Index
ssi_3d.definition: Mean SSI over the three complete days before event rainfall begins.

ssi_7d.label: Seven-day antecedent Soil Saturation Index
ssi_7d.definition: Mean SSI over the seven complete days before event rainfall begins.

ssi_30d.label: Thirty-day antecedent Soil Saturation Index
ssi_30d.definition: Mean SSI over the thirty complete days before event rainfall begins.
